subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or supersede the open cross-repo PR before starting any new repair for this cron stagger bug?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and small, but there is already an open non-upstream, non-maintainer-editable PR with closing syntax, so automation should not duplicate contributor work without a maintainer path decision.

options.title: Supersede with an upstream fix
options.body: Close or supersede the cross-repo PR with a narrow upstream fix while preserving contributor credit if it cannot be landed directly.

options.title: Ask for a retargeted PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the contributor work and ask the author to open a maintainer-editable upstream PR against `openclaw/openclaw`.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the linked PR as-is, accepting that the bug remains open without a landable upstream branch.

recommendation.title: Supersede with an upstream fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the cross-repo PR with a narrow upstream fix while preserving contributor credit if it cannot be landed directly.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the default stagger helper and surrounding cron defaulting behavior, making them the strongest routing candidate for the adoption/replacement decision.
